{{Top|leg}}
'''Clan boars''' were those [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] within a clan who were married. Important and respected, clan boars had an income due to their wives' lands. They formed the central core of the clan's army and [[clan-guard]]. Clan boars could never hope to aspire to the rank of [[Warlord (Gamorrean)/Legends|warlord]] unless their wife died and they subsequently remarried a [[Matron/Legends|matron]], or their wife inherited a matronage.
